get.description:
Where every golden reference photo comes from, its author and licence (SOURCES.md), plus
the product table parsed into rows.
Schema carrier for the `GET /v1/runs/{id}/events` payloads (always empty).

post.description:
Upload a product photo. Idempotent by content: the same image returns the existing product
with 200. The client filename and content type are ignored.

When a vision judge is configured the product profile (box, colours, label text as data) is
extracted now and stored in `reference_facts`; otherwise it is `unverified` until a run can
compute it.

200.description: The same image was uploaded before

get.description: The authoritative snapshot of a run (reload-safe; the UI rebuilds its timeline from it).

post.description: Stop an active run: its task is cancelled and the run ends `cancelled`.

Human release: approve or reject a `passed` / `needs_review` run (audited).

Approving a `needs_review` run overrides the gate: `reason` is required, and the decision is
also stored as a human label on the approved image.

get.description:
SSE: replays events with `seq > Last-Event-ID`, then tails until `run.finished`, then closes.

Keep-alive comments every 15 s. Works after the run has ended (full replay).
